calls.statement: SELECT week_ending_date, store_key, product_key, closing_units, closing_value, receipts_units, adjustment_units, etl_loaded_at FROM fact_stock_week WHERE store_key = 30 AND product_key = 11 AND week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-06' ORDER BY week_ending_date, etl_loaded_at

SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date AS wk_end, SUM(f.quantity) AS sold, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dl FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE f.store_key=30 AND f.product_key=11 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT week_ending_date, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT store_key||'-'||product_key) AS dn, SUM(closing_units) su, MAX(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-09-13' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
